document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: analyze_spacing
tools.description: Analyze spacing values (gap, padding) across the current page. Checks grid compliance.

anyOf.description: Base grid size to check against (default: 8)
Base grid size to check against (default: 8)

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: analyze_clusters
tools.description: Find repeated design patterns (potential components). Groups nodes by structural signature — type, size, and child structure.

anyOf.description: Min instances to form a cluster (default: 2)
Min instances to form a cluster (default: 2)

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: analyze_overlaps
tools.description: Detect visual overlaps and layout overflows across the current page. Useful for finding content that covers footers, text that bleeds outside frames, and accidental sibling overlaps.

scope.description: Which pairs to inspect: all, same-parent, cross-parent, top-level, inside-parent (default: all)

category.description: Comma-separated categories: sibling-overlap, parent-overflow, overlay (default: all)

severity.description: Minimum severity to include: critical, major, minor, info (default: info)

anyOf.description: Minimum overlap area in square pixels (default: 0)
Minimum overlap area in square pixels (default: 0)
Minimum overlap ratio relative to the smaller node, 0.0–1.0 (default: 0)
Minimum overlap ratio relative to the smaller node, 0.0–1.0 (default: 0)

include_hidden.description: Include hidden nodes in the analysis

include_locked.description: Include locked nodes in the analysis

include_absolute.description: Include absolutely-positioned nodes in the analysis

page.description: Limit analysis to nodes on the named page

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

type.description: Comma-separated node types to analyze, e.g. FRAME,TEXT

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

tools.name: diff_create
tools.description: Create a structural diff between two node trees. Compares properties (fills, strokes, effects, text, size, position) in unified diff format.

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: diff_show
tools.description: Preview what would change if properties were applied to a node. Shows a unified diff of current vs proposed state.

props.description: JSON object of new properties, e.g. '{"opacity": 1, "fill": "#FF0000", "width": 200}'

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: design_to_tokens
tools.description: Extract design tokens from Figma variables as CSS custom properties, Tailwind theme config, or JSON. Resolves aliases, handles multiple modes (light/dark).

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: design_to_component_map
tools.description: Analyze the document and return a structured component decomposition: components (with variants, props, instance counts), screens, and a dependency overview.

page.description: Page name to analyze (default: current page)

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List open OpenPencil documents/tabs with their IDs, file paths, current pages, and pages.

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save the current document to disk. If path is provided, it must be inside the configured MCP root.

path.description: Path for the .fig file, absolute or relative to the MCP root

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open a .fig or .pen file from inside the configured MCP root.

path.description: Path to the design file, absolute or relative to the MCP root

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: new_document
tools.description: Create a new empty document with an optional save path inside the configured MCP root.

path.description: Path for the new file, absolute or relative to the MCP root

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: close_file
tools.description: Close an open document tab, prompting to save unsaved changes.

document_id.description: Optional OpenPencil document/tab ID to target

page_id.description: Optional page ID to target within the document

tools.name: get_codegen_prompt
tools.description: Get design-to-code generation guidelines. Call before generating frontend code.
